description: Ask the developer a question about an annotation instead of resolving it — when the request is ambiguous, or you need a decision before you change code. They read your message on the pin in their browser and answer there; the note then comes back to you as pending with the whole conversation attached (it reaches wait_for_annotation and the Claude Code hook like a new note). Until they answer it is off the pending list. Never use this to report a finished change — that is resolve_annotation.

message.description: Your question or message, shown to the developer on the pin

name: reply_annotation
title: Ask the developer about a note
